name: alakazam_ml_v22
model: The v20 LightGBM ranker, features, confidence threshold, live scope, and 60-card deck are unchanged. v22 modifies only deterministic attack-chain control.
model_scope: Live ML remains restricted to guarded Abra/Dunsparce bench-role choice and same-evolution-card target choice. Attack, Energy, Trainer, Boss, Hammer, retreat, abilities, END, promotion, and effect-driven switching remain deterministic.

source_evidence.interpretation: v20 already has top-level first-attack speed and attack-opportunity conversion. The durable gap is converting deck cards into a parallel second attacker and useful Dudunsparce cycles, especially in Archaludon and Grimmsnarl prize races.

v22_rule_changes: Classify deterministic benched backup attack ETA as 0, 1, 2, or unknown.
Raise benched Dudunsparce only when backup ETA exceeds one, while retaining deck floors and terminal routes.
Stop surplus Dudunsparce only when current effective attack, one-turn backup, Energy, and a soft hand buffer are all secured.
Re-bench the first Dunsparce before a redundant third Alakazam-line body, with a late spread-prize prune.
Pre-attach Psychic Energy to a deterministic benched Abra/Kadabra route after current Alakazam offense is online.
Separate KO promotion from end-turn Abra/Dunsparce switching: attack route first after KO, recyclable single-prize shield after an end-turn switch.
Boost live Darkness-Energy Munkidori in visible Grimmsnarl/Froslass boards without enabling broad evolution-family heuristics.
Keep ordinary Fezandipiti ex as recovery only; no progressive alternate-attacker build.
preserved_v20_invariants: Rare Candy immediate attack and KO routing
Mist Energy Hammer memory and reservation
deck floors and only-body Dudunsparce prohibition
late Fezandipiti ex two-prize exposure gates
known_limitations: A new live ladder rating has not been measured; rating 900 or 1000 stability is a goal, not a validated outcome.
Teacher-forced comparison does not simulate counterfactual board trajectories after a changed action.
No official cg package is present locally, so a final submission tar.gz was not built.
The model was intentionally not retrained because its live scope does not control the primary v22 decisions.
